findings.found: The reader numbers chapters from 1: ch00 becomes "1. Overview", ch01 "2. The classical theory", ..., ch07 "8. ...". Every equation/theorem number in the reader is shifted by +1 in the chapter digit relative to the PDF (e.g. thm:c3-acyclic is Theorem 3.19 in the PDF and Theorem 4.19 in the reader; eq:c4-ict is (4.1) in the PDF while the reader tag (4.1) belongs to eq:c3-QP). The 67 prose references "Chapter N" (ch00:46,57-113; ch03-ch07) point to the wrong reader heading.
findings.rule: FORMAT.md: one manuscript converted to the reader AND compiled to PDF; cross references must agree.
findings.replacement: In Converter.run, before self.parse_body(text) for each file f, set the chapter counter from the file name so that \chapter increments to the file number: `self.chap = int(f.name[2:4]) - 1`. (All 195 labels otherwise agree between reader and PDF after the uniform offset; checked.)

findings.replacement: Remark (Method of computation): "Each per-graph coefficient is an exact rational number. It is obtained in an explicit realisation of $V_{10}$, $\Sigma$ and $\mathfrak g$, over $\mathbb Q(i)$, with the loop momentum integrated as a Gaussian (Lemma \ref{lem:c4-gauss}) and the $\varepsilon$-expansion taken on the graphs with one pinned edge (Proposition \ref{prop:c4-boundary}); for the two-point graphs polarisations and momenta are symbolic. The colour factors are reduced exactly for a general simple $\mathfrak g$." 789: "Equivalently, the longitudinal parts of the graphs of the $A|_V$ two-point function, with every edge cut off at $\varepsilon$, sum to $-\tfrac92\varepsilon^{-1}$ and $-\tfrac{27}8$; ..."

findings.replacement: \begin{remark}[Method of computation] The entries of the table of Proposition \ref{prop:c5-table} are exact rational multiples of $\operatorname{tr}_{\mathfrak g}(\mathrm{ad}_X\mathrm{ad}_Y)/(X,Y)$: in explicit realisations of $V_{10}$, of the Clifford module and of $\mathfrak g=\mathfrak{su}(2)$ and $\mathfrak{su}(3)$, the Schwinger integrals of each graph are integrated in closed form in exact rational arithmetic and the singular part is read off from the exact $\varepsilon$-expansion, with the same multiples for both gauge algebras. The graphs (a)--(f) are all one-loop graphs with one vertex $O$ on the cycle and superficial degree $\ge0$ (Proposition \ref{prop:c5-census}). \end{remark}

findings.replacement: \begin{remark}[Method of computation] The limits of Proposition \ref{prop:c6-Leps} are evaluated exactly in explicit realisations of $\mathfrak g=\mathfrak{su}(2)$ and $\mathfrak{su}(3)$: each boundary integral of the Schwinger parametrisation with one edge at $t=\varepsilon$ is computed in closed form in exact rational arithmetic, edge by edge; each edge of a degree-$0$ graph carries the fraction of Lemma \ref{lem:c5-log}. \end{remark}
